restrictions: This entry uses the exact two-round BLAKE3 55/63-byte non-root last-chunk half-collision construction from proof.md. The type-conditioned test-(2) DFA enforces f9 xor f10 = 1 and f24 xor f25 = 1 xor t, t = (Y4 bit4 xor Y4 bit5), with the two exact lists selected from the member type. Each list entry is first tested by the exact prefilter (Y9 + 0x044) AND 0x387 = 0 (Lemma PF) on a 256-lane bit-sliced kernel of 1,179 gates (X0, the low-half Y9 fill on bits 0 to 9, the test): enumeration of condition (1) over all 1024 low-10-bit prefixes leaves 14, all among the 16 passing prefixes, so a lane that does not pass skips E work losslessly. A pass lane is extracted (19 operations) and completed by the packed 33-unit fill, the 10-unit completion of Y1 and Y9' and the 3-unit word test (54 with its load, X0, the addition to W and the E lane).

The walk (this entry): every member walks seven full blocks of 2^16 steps, s = L0 + 1 to L0 + 7 * 2^16 with t_hi = s XOR (ROL(K1.d1,16) mod 2^19) below 2^19, starting where X0 mod 2^16 is 2^16 - 1 (Lemma W7); on a full block every listed high half names one step, so a live block reads the first copy of its state's list whole in written-out code (Lemma LW): 24 units per live block, 11 per block, no pieces, ranges or partial words. t < 2^51 and both messages are below 2^61 bytes (memory_log2_bytes 63 covers both with the search and SEL).

The 2^19 members fall into 16 list classes of 32768 (member type t and e1 bits 2, 26, 27). Each member reads only the list words alive for its class (Lemma CP: the omega of a listed good trial is alive). The 16 lists come from an exact enumeration with one representative member per class (462791680 tests, kept counts summing to 389525760 = 16 * 24345360); each equals its state's typed list cut by a 128-bit mask on bits 16 to 22 of omega, which the program carries and checks (kept counts, fully checked lanes and planted roots, sampled cut words). E_KEPT = 24345360 replaces E_COUNT = 28924480 in the E budget; the pass, MU and live-block budgets are not lowered. That one member decides its class is the premise H_class. BUILD = 834078790425024 is charged once; a member is 71 units.

Charged-cost tightenings of unchanged work: a passing lane's scan is a certified 12 units (passing lane 52, for 61); the context constant is 436 (for 500); the H1' listed-good-trial factor is 0.974 (for 0.970); SEL is charged S_old = 5486510246044225536 (116 pairs at their caps, proof.md Section 12). N = 48662295102955122561, log2(N/430) = 56.65124532, rounded up to 56.6513. Budgets, certificate, memory and premises are in the first section and the ledger appendix of proof.md. H_PF (lane) is a premise of this entry (first section); H4', H_G_cluster and H5_screen (MU = 0.004025, change H) are carried from the walk's PLAN6 and 8947920c's PREREG6W4.

Change I (this entry): the list word is tested by the 256-lane bit-sliced kernel, 1,201 operations a batch, 73 a pass lane, 124 a live block, 420 a context and 150 a member for constant planes, 2^28 once: -0.10467 bit; it replaces the kept-word budget of change F and the six-unit prefilter of change G (their bits are consumed). Change H (from 8947920c): MU = 0.004025 from its preregistered PREREG6W4 (16384 whole contexts, mean 0.0037673, SE 0.0000429), cited, not rerun; it was measured on Th0rgal's program (see proof.md first section).

Machine, a premise of this entry (H3): a 256-bit word RAM with loads, stores and 1,024 registers of 256 bits, counted as memory (32,768 bytes), as in the blake3-r3 entry 0a9640ed. Every gate, load, store, comparison, branch and addition to W is one operation; no multiplication, division or remainder. The batch loop uses 304 registers, the extraction 256 and the solver and packed path at most 64: 624, no spill. A batch of 256 list entries is 1,201 operations; a pass lane is 73.

heuristics.statement: The inherited listed-good-trial rate and context-level dependence premise of the fa97a08f construction, at the declared rate factor 0.974 (the base filed 0.970); unchanged by the typed-list filtering, the prefilter and the class lists.
heuristics.scope: The same 55/63-byte, flags-3, non-root counter walk and exact solver construction, with the same run length and expected count 0.49594.
heuristics.extrapolation: The rate and dependence are inherited; typed lists, the prefilter and the class lists only remove words that cannot hold a listed good trial (the class lists under H_class), and no change of this entry alters which trials are searched. The factor 0.974 is a declared premise of this entry (change D), supported by the inherited preregistered samples cited in Section 13, not by a new measurement.
heuristics.limitations: This remains a heuristic premise, not a theorem.

heuristics.statement: For a step whose omega is in the list of its member's class, the E-lane and pass counts are at most 1.000173 and 1.002882 times their exact shares, E_KEPT/2^32 per listed step and 14110208*E_COUNT/2^64 per step, plus a Hoeffding reserve over contexts. The class lists only remove list words that cannot hold a listed good trial, so they do not raise either count.
heuristics.scope: All RUN_STEPS outer steps of the full-block walk.
heuristics.extrapolation: Preregistered PLAN6 Part A, 2^36 independent walk steps with the program's own tables: 462,791,000 typed E steps (0.999999 of the exact share) and 1,520,165 passing steps (0.99984); the lower-tail Chernoff rule at exp(-7) gives the factors.

heuristics.statement: The mean metered debit of the declared program per outer step of the full-block walk (the screen's 64 + 20|T| plus the lane's 15 call-only units plus the executed solver ledger) is at most MU = 0.004025 machine units: the mean of the preregistered PREREG6W4 run of Th0rgal's entry 8947920c on the class-list walk (16,384 whole contexts, 0.0037673 per step, standard error 4.29e-05) plus six standard errors, rounded up to 10^-6 (the base used 0.004652 from PLAN6, 0.0043668 per step); the credit adds a Bernstein reserve (L_C = CAPX * 7 * 2^19) and a preflight reserve.
heuristics.scope: The unchanged screen and capped solver on the typed-list walk of seven full blocks per member, over the 2^69.862 outer steps of the run.
heuristics.extrapolation: From PLAN6 Part B, 16,384 whole contexts of the declared program (16,384 * 7 * 2^19 = 2^35.807 outer steps, about 2^-34.06 of the run) to the run. The rule (mean plus six standard errors over contexts, rounded up to 10^-6) was written before the run and the whole sample was used: mean 0.0043668 per step, standard error 4.75e-05, MU = 0.004652. No MU scaling.
heuristics.limitations: The debit has a heavy tail (solver calls are rare, one call can debit up to 23151 units), the standard error is a statistical margin and not a proof, the seeds are pseudorandom, and the true mean is not proved. The Bernstein reserve bounds the run total given the mean, not the mean. The run of PREREG6W4 was made with the program of 8947920c, not with the program shipped here; the debit of a call does not depend on the prefilter, but this transfer is a premise, cited and not rerun.

heuristics.statement: A block of a walk context is live on average at most 1.000048 times as often as a uniform low half of omega (4,160 of 2^16 for each type), so a context has on average at most that share of its 56 blocks live; the live-block budget adds a Hoeffding reserve over contexts.
heuristics.scope: The 56 full blocks of every context of the run.
heuristics.extrapolation: Preregistered PLAN6 Part A: 30,534,464,639 live blocks among the seven of 2^36 independent members, 0.999998 of the model share; the one-sided empirical Bernstein rule at exp(-7) gives the factor.
heuristics.limitations: The live share of a block depends on the outer words and the member, whose law is not proved uniform.

heuristics.statement: For a uniform context, (a) the expected number of listed lanes whose low ten Y9 bits are among the 16 prefixes of Lemma PF is at most 0.0165 times the expected number of listed lanes, (b) the expected number of listed entries is at least 0.98 times its exact value on the class lists, and (c) the padding of a live block's list to a multiple of 256 lanes averages at most 108 lanes over the live states of the 16 class lists.
heuristics.scope: The pass-lane, batch and padding work budgets of the counter walk; they do not affect the rate, the walk or which trials are found.
heuristics.extrapolation: Part (c) is computed by the program (107.75). Part (a): uniform Y9 bits would pass 16/1024 = 0.015625; the self-test's two whole contexts pass 0.015700 and four requests of 256 trials with our own seeds 0.01472 to 0.01584; the base's preregistered PREREG6W3 kept 0.10459 of its list words, so at least 0.01494 per lane and about 0.01566 if the lanes of a word were independent. The declared experiment ends with an error if its sampled pass share exceeds 0.0165 by more than four binomial standard errors. Part (b) as in the base (PREREG6W3: 1.00013 of the exact count).
heuristics.limitations: Part (a) is a declared premise (1.056 times the uniform share) resting on these counts, not on a theorem or a preregistered run of this program; the experiment's counts are untrusted. If it failed the run would halt at W = WB and only the success probability would fall.

heuristics.statement: For each of the 16 list classes (member type t and e1 bits 2, 26, 27) and each typed E word of its type, the word is alive for all 32768 members of the class or for none, so the list built with the class's representative member is the list of every member (with Lemma CP, no listed good trial is skipped).
heuristics.scope: The 16 class lists of the counter walk; it bears on the success probability only, since the work of the walk is that of the stored lists.
heuristics.extrapolation: An exact deterministic enumeration (462791680 tests) with cross-member checks within each class found no disagreement; the program checks the kept count of each walked member's list, that the omega of every fully checked lane and planted root is kept, and that sampled cut words are not alive; two of the fifteen free directions are proved.
heuristics.limitations: Thirteen of the fifteen directions are not proved; an exhaustive check would cost about 2^63 word operations. If the premise failed, a member could miss listed good trials and the success probability would fall below the stated value.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical premise of this entry. The cost model prices a 256-bit word RAM with loads and stores and fixes no register count; this entry declares R = 1,024 registers of 256 bits, counted as 32,768 bytes of memory, and charges every operation, load, store, comparison and branch. A bit-sliced batch (1,201 operations for 256 list entries) has no store or move; the batch loop needs 304 registers, the extraction 256 and the solver and packed path at most 64.
heuristics.scope: The list-word stage of the counter walk (first section of proof.md); the rest of the program keeps the register counts stated in its sections, which fit in the declared file.
heuristics.extrapolation: The blake3-r3 entry 0a9640ed makes the same declaration and passed the paired review. The program builds the kernel at start, assigns registers by last use (304) and asserts the figures 1,179, 304, 222, 1,201 and 73.
heuristics.limitations: With fewer registers the loop would need loads and stores that this entry does not count; the premise is that 1,024 are available.
